prompt.en: In Ontario, which industries does the guide say produce a large share of Canada's exports?
prompt.fr: En Ontario, quelles industries produisent une grande partie des exportations du Canada, selon le guide?

options.en: Taking oil from the oil sands.
options.fr: L'extraction du pétrole des sables bitumineux.
Les industries des services et de la fabrication.

explanation.en: Many people in Ontario work in services or in factories, and what those industries produce makes up a large part of what Canada sells to other countries.
explanation.fr: Beaucoup de gens en Ontario travaillent dans les services ou dans les usines, et ce que produisent ces industries représente une grande partie de ce que le Canada vend à d'autres pays.

source.quote: Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

verification.evidence: Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports. … Service industries provide thousands of different jobs in areas like transportation, education, health care, construction, banking, communications, retail services, tourism and government.
